ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice.
He who hates you is the loser.
sw: Basi sali na uchinje kwa ajili ya Mola wako Mlezi.
Hakika anaye kuchukia ndiye aliye mpungufu.
fr: Accomplis la Salât pour ton Seigneur et sacrifie.
Celui qui te hait sera certes, sans postérité.
